title: rottboellia cymbachne
intro: Rottboellia cymbachne, commonly known as Rottboellia or Cymbachne, is a plant species in the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine and has been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help in treating fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion, and as a bronchodilator, making it easier to breathe. Rottboellia cymbachne contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
